runtime.temperature: unavailable: not settable in this runtime
runtime.max_tokens: unavailable: not settable in this runtime
runtime.api_request_ids: recorded per attempt as request_ids, from the subagent transcripts
runtime.structured_output: StructuredOutput tool. Its schema is output_schema.json without the $schema, $id, $comment and title annotation keywords; every response is re-validated against the full output_schema.json with validateAgainstSchema.
runtime.retry_policy: one retry of a run that returns no structured output
runtime.tools: the runtime's full tool set was available; the transcript audit records every tool call
runtime.injected_context: Each subagent received the runtime's standard context: the workflow subagent system prompt, an environment snapshot, the date, a skill listing, deferred tool and MCP instructions, and the maintainer's auto-memory index, which mentions the DD library, the July review and p2's candidate status. The context was identical for both arms. The pre-registered runtime description did not mention it.

prompts.control: p1: harness/review_prompt.md verbatim, with the original type block, hindsight v1 and rubric.md
prompts.candidate: p2: harness/prompt_versions.md, with the p2 type block, hindsight v1 and rubric.md
prompts.delivery: The assembled prompt is the subagent's task. The workflow script rebuilt each prompt and checked its FNV-1a digest before starting any agent; the audit compares each transcript's prompt with the assembled prompt's SHA-256.
prompts.control_output_path: absolute scratch path outside the repository, one per run

packets.text_source: fliphtml5.com book pages saved from a browser by the maintainer on 2026-09-16 (file times 18:30-18:32 EDT). Direct fetches return a Cloudflare bot challenge, and the online.fliphtml5.com reader has no text layer.
packets.parser: extractPageText from harness/extract_book_text.mjs at cd6b59c, which accepts P:NN markers
packets.coverage: a sample for every book: the saved pages omit the first two pages and the last one to three pages
packets.control_header: reconstructed from p1's description (TITLE, BYLINE, OFFICIAL PAGE COUNT, UPLOAD DATE, TEXT COVERAGE); the July packets were not preserved
packets.delivery: absolute scratch path read with the Read tool
packets.coverage_header_note: The run's TEXT COVERAGE headers gave only the first and last included page. For #45, #99 and #108 they did not disclose pages missing inside that range (see books[].missing_pages_within_range). Both arms received identical headers. assemble_review.mjs now lists every contiguous range.
